entities.summary: Peter Max is a German-American artist known for using bright colors in his work. Works by Max are associated with the visual arts and culture of the 1960s, particularly psychedelic art and pop art. Peter Max was a architects & designers from Berlin (b. 1937-10-19, Berlin). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
